sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 80. Heals HP.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (2 times).
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 20 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Increases light elemental attack by 8 for 60 seconds.
Boosts stats of light Monsters by 10% when equipped in the Main Slot.
